mapper.select: SELECT task_id FROM tb_early_warning WHERE node_id = #{deviceId} and warning_type = #{warningType} and is_affirm = '2'
select node_id from tb_early_warning where repair_id = #{id}

select id,warning_grade warningGrade,warning_type warningType,is_affirm affirm,node_id nodeId from tb_early_warning where node_id like concat('%',concat(#{nodeId},'%')) and is_affirm in (1,2) and rownum = 1 and warning_type =#{warningType}
select setting_value from tb_general_setting where setting_key = #{settingKey} order by id

select DISTINCT (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_early_warning where instr(warning_grade, '3') > 0 and id in #{id} ) AS threeWarningCount, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_early_warning where instr(warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 and id in #{id} ) AS twoWarningCount, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_early_warning where instr(warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 and id in #{id} ) AS oneWarningCount from tb_early_warning
select warning_type from tb_early_warning where id in #{id} group by warning_type order by warning_type

select to_char(warning_time,'SYYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "time",principal as "principal" from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = #{affirm} and warning_type in ('01','02','03') warning_type = #{warningType} and site_route = #{siteRoute} and rownum = 1 order by warning_time
select site_x as "siteX",site_y as "siteY",site_z as "siteZ" from tb_node where node_id in #{nodeId}
select count(*) from tb_early_warning where node_id = #{nodeId} and is_affirm in (1,2) and warning_type = #{warningType}
mapper.insert:
insert into tb_early_warning ( warning_type, node_id, node_type, warning_val,warning_time, warning_val_one,warning_time_one, warning_val_two,warning_time_two, warning_val_three,warning_time_three, warning_grade, stack_id, area_id, principal, site_route, task_id, is_affirm ) values ( #{earlyWarning.warningType}, #{earlyWarning.nodeId}, #{earlyWarning.nodeType},
#{earlyWarning.warningVal},sysdate,
#{earlyWarning.warningValOne},sysdate,
#{earlyWarning.warningValTwo},sysdate,
#{earlyWarning.warningValThree},sysdate, #{earlyWarning.warningGrade}, #{earlyWarning.stackId}, #{earlyWarning.areaId}, #{earlyWarning.principalName}, #{earlyWarning.siteRoute}, #{earlyWarning.taskId}, 2 )
mapper.update: update tb_early_warning set node_id = #{earlyWarning.nodeId}, warning_grade = #{earlyWarning.warningGrade}, warning_val = #{earlyWarning.warningVal}, warning_val_one = #{earlyWarning.warningValOne},warning_time_one = sysdate, warning_val_two = #{earlyWarning.warningValTwo},warning_time_two = sysdate, warning_val_three = #{earlyWarning.warningValThree},warning_time_three = sysdate, warning_time = sysdate where id = #{earlyWarning.id}
mapper.select: select node_id nodeId, node_type nodeType, warning_val_one warningValOne, warning_time_one warningTimeOne from tb_early_warning where warning_type in ('01','02','03') and is_affirm = 2

SELECT t.node_id as nodeId,t.warning_type as warningType,t.warning_val as warningVal,t.principal as principalName,t.deal_time as dealTime, t.stack_id as stackId,t.area_id as areaId,a.deal_method as dealSuggestion,a.deal_result as remark, CASE WHEN instr(t.warning_grade, '3') > 0 THEN '3' WHEN instr(t.warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(t.warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '2' WHEN instr(t.warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(t.warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(t.warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '1' END as warningGrade FROM tb_early_warning t left join tb_task a on a.id = t.task_id WHERE is_affirm = '0' and t.site_route like concat(concat('%',#{earlyWarningDto.pidRoute}),'%') and t.warning_type = #{earlyWarningDto.warningType} and CASE WHEN instr(t.warning_grade, '3') > 0 THEN '3' WHEN instr(t.warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(t.warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '2' WHEN instr(t.warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(t.warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(t.warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '1' END = #{earlyWarningDto.warningGrade} and t.node_id like concat(concat('%',#{earlyWarningDto.nodeId}),'%') and t.principal like concat(concat('%',#{earlyWarningDto.principalName}),'%') and t.deal_time >= #{earlyWarningDto.startTime} and t.deal_time <= #{earlyWarningDto.endTime} ORDER BY t.deal_time desc

SELECT id FROM tb_early_warning where 1=1 and site_route like concat(concat('%',#{earlyWarningDto.pidRoute}),'%') and warning_type = #{earlyWarningDto.warningType} and principal like concat(concat('%',#{earlyWarningDto.principalName}),'%') and warning_time >= TO_DATE(#{earlyWarningDto.beginTime}, 'SYYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) and warning_time <= TO_DATE(#{earlyWarningDto.finishTime}, 'SYYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) and CASE WHEN instr(warning_grade, '3') > 0 THEN '3' WHEN instr(warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '2' WHEN instr(warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '1' END = #{earlyWarningDto.warningGrade}
SELECT count(1) as "sum",warning_type AS "warningType" FROM tb_early_warning WHERE 1=1 and id in #{id} GROUP BY warning_type ORDER BY warning_type

select warning_val_one as "warningValOne",warning_val_two as "warningValTwo",warning_val_three as "warningValThree",to_char(warning_time_one,'SYYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "warningTimeOne", to_char(warning_time_two,'SYYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "warningTimeTwo",to_char(warning_time_three,'SYYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "warningTimeThree" from tb_early_warning where id= #{id}
select task_id from tb_early_warning where id = #{id}
select count(*) from tb_early_warning where node_id = #{nodeId} and is_affirm in (1,2)
mapper.update: update tb_early_warning set is_affirm = 2 where node_id = #{nodeId} and warning_type = #{warningType} and rownum = 1
mapper.select: select (select setting_value from tb_general_setting where setting_key = 'color' and setting_name = 'one') as "oneColor", (select setting_value from tb_general_setting where setting_key = 'color' and setting_name = 'two') as "twoColor", (select setting_value from tb_general_setting where setting_key = 'color' and setting_name = 'three') as "threeColor" from tb_general_setting where rownum =1
select distinct site_route as "route",principal as "principal",stack_id as "stackId",area_id as "areaId" from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and site_route = #{siteRoute}

select LISTAGG(t.id, ',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY t.id) as "id",t.site_route as "siteRoute" from (select id,site_route from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and instr(warning_grade, '3') > 0 union select id,site_route from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and warning_type in ('01','02','03')) t group by t.site_route
SELECT site_name FROM tb_stack where id = #{stackId}
select site_name from tb_ware_area where id = #{areaId}

select warning_type as "warningType",node_id as "nodeId", CASE WHEN instr(warning_grade, '3') > 0 THEN warning_val_three WHEN instr(warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN warning_val_two WHEN instr(warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN warning_val_one END as "warningVal" from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and id in #{id}
select count(*) from tb_early_warning where node_id in (select pest_board_id from tb_pest_board where id in #{id})

select COALESCE(count(1),0) AS "count", COALESCE(count(DECODE(CASE WHEN instr(warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '1' end, '1' , 1, NULL)),0) AS "oneWarningCount", COALESCE(count(DECODE(CASE WHEN instr(warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '2' end, '2' , 1, NULL)),0) AS "twoWarningCount", COALESCE(count(DECODE(CASE WHEN instr(warning_grade, '3') > 0 THEN '3' end, '3' , 1, NULL)),0) AS "threeWarningCount" from tb_early_warning where is_affirm in('1','2')
select '01' as "warningType", '设备故障' as "warningName", COALESCE(count(1),0) AS "warningTypeCount" from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and warning_type in ('01','02','03')
select COALESCE(count(1),0) from tb_early_warning where is_affirm in ('1','2') and warning_type = #{warningType} GROUP BY warning_type
select COALESCE(count(1),0) from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and warning_type in ('01','02','03')

select id as "id",node_type as "nodeType",area_id as "areaId",stack_id as "stackId",principal as "principal",site_route as "siteRoute",warning_grade as "grade",node_id as "nodeId",warning_type as "warningType", CASE WHEN instr(warning_grade, '3') > 0 THEN '3' WHEN instr(warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '2' WHEN instr(warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '1' END AS "warningGrade", to_char(CASE WHEN instr(warning_grade, '3') > 0 THEN warning_val_three WHEN instr(warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN warning_val_two WHEN instr(warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN warning_val_one END,'FM999.00') AS "warningVal", to_char(CASE WHEN instr(warning_grade, '3') > 0 THEN warning_time_three WHEN instr(warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN warning_time_two WHEN instr(warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN warning_time_one END,'SYYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS "warningTime" from tb_early_warning where is_affirm in('1','2') and warning_type = #{warningType} and CASE WHEN instr(warning_grade, '3') > 0 THEN '3' WHEN instr(warning_grade, '2') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '2' WHEN instr(warning_grade, '1') > 0 and instr(warning_grade, '2') = 0 and instr(warning_grade, '3') = 0 THEN '1' END = #{warningGrade}

SELECT id,node_id nodeId,warning_grade AS warningGrade,warning_type warningType,is_affirm affirm, warning_val warningVal,warning_val_one warningValOne,warning_val_two warningValTwo,warning_val_three warningValThree FROM tb_early_warning where site_route =#{siteRoute} and is_affirm in (1,2) and rownum = 1 and warning_type =#{warningType}
select beetle_count as "beetle",mealworm_count as "mealworm" from tb_pest_data_history where pest_board_id = #{nodeId}
select principal from tb_early_warning where id = #{id}

SELECT id AS "id",area_id AS "areaId",stack_id AS "stackId",is_affirm AS "affirm",node_type AS "nodeType",principal as "principal", warning_grade as "warningGrade",site_route as "siteRoute",to_char(warning_time_one,'SYYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "warningTime",warning_type as "warningType" FROM tb_early_warning where id in (SELECT max(id) from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and warning_type in ('01','02','03') group by site_route,node_type,warning_type) ORDER BY is_affirm DESC
select node_id from tb_early_warning where site_route =#{siteRoute} and is_affirm = '2' and warning_type = #{warningType} and node_type = #{nodeType}
